5d81aaf7-4f67-4125-bf33-11493cc7eab7.description: rejects span longer than string length
5d81aaf7-4f67-4125-bf33-11493cc7eab7.comment: Replacement case: superseded by 0ae1ce53-d9ba-41bb-827f-2fceb64f058b which tests assert(span <= len, "span must not exceed string length") using AWK length($1).

06bc8b90-0c51-4c54-ac22-3ec3893a079e.description: reports 1 for empty string and empty product (0 span)
06bc8b90-0c51-4c54-ac22-3ec3893a079e.comment: Unsupported behavior: in AWK field splitting with FS=",", empty digits yield empty $1 (length 0), failing validation assert($1 ~ /^[[:digit:]]+$/) and assert(span > 0).

3ec0d92e-f2e2-4090-a380-70afee02f4c0.description: reports 1 for nonempty string and empty product (0 span)
3ec0d92e-f2e2-4090-a380-70afee02f4c0.comment: Unsupported behavior: span 0 on non-empty string produces degenerate 0-length slices in substr($1, i, span) and split("", digits, ""); excluded as contract requires positive spans (assert(span > 0)).
